title: Two letters in Girolamo Sirtori's cipher (to Andres de Prada and to Juan Baptista de Tassis), Valladolid 1604, in Luis Valle de la Cerda's papers (BNE Mss/994 ff. 85r, 86r-86v; Cryptoole ITXXXX-1)

documents.shelfmark: Madrid, Biblioteca Nacional, Mss/994, ff. 85r (letter, margin 'Andres de Prada') and 86r-86v (letter, margin 'Juan Baptista de Tassis'); BDH bdh0000174344
documents.route: unknown writer using Sirtori's cipher -> Andres de Prada and Juan Baptista de Tassis (Dudout 2026); papers passed to Luis Valle de la Cerda by a secretary of the Council of State

transcription.source: Sara Gomez Hernandez's 27-symbol stream (via Pelling, Cipher Mysteries, 14 June 2012); Eloy Caballero's word-divided f. 85 (Cipher Mysteries comment, 31 July 2012)
transcription.notes: 747 signs counted by solve_stream.py (631 letters + 116 digits; _check_profile.py --letters gives 631). The stream drops word divisions, dots, commas, arcs and loop counts. Images: Pelling's 2012 web copies, about 950 x 1480 px; the BDH copy (140 ppi per Dudout) was behind a browser check.

system.summary: Cursive invented signs (about 20-27) in space-separated groups of 1-4 signs, almost every group followed by a dot or comma, with tall strokes and loop chains; not a letter-for-letter substitution.
system.notes: Groups on f. 85: 94, with 206 signs (2.19 per group), lengths 1/2/3/4 = 13/59/26/3%. Spanish syllables 8/56/29/6% (Italian 7/55/31/5%), but no set of signs occurs once per group (64%, shuffled 60-63%, real Spanish syllables 89%). Word division 'kept' means space-separated groups; whether a group is a word is not established.

prior_solution.where: Eloy Caballero, tentative Latin reading of f. 85, Cipher Mysteries comments 31 July - 1 Aug 2012; not accepted (catalogue review 20 Oct 2026)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: pasted the catalogue task text; no target-specific intervention.
tools: solve_stream.py (many-to-one substitution anneal with matched controls)
vowel_set_test.py (exhaustive vowel-set search with shuffled control)

solution.what: BDH / bnedigital.bne.es: HTTP 403 to scripts and a Cloudflare human check in the browser, not passed. Took Pelling's 2012 copies of ff. 85, 86r, 86v and Gomez's sign key.
Cryptiana valle.htm (folios, f. 90 dated 7 Oct 1604) and the Cipher Mysteries post with comments (Gomez stream, Caballero's Latin and his caveats): no decipherment.
Copied Gomez's 747-sign stream and Caballero's word-divided f. 85; counted the words of f. 85 on the image (94, the same as Caballero's division).
Gomez stream: IC 1.84 (x26); the tall stroke '3' follows F or B 76 of 85 times, so F3/B3 are better single signs.

Signs per word: f. 85 has 2.19 signs per group against 4.27 (es), 4.69 (it), 5.68 (la) letters per word. Letter-for-letter substitution of whole words excluded; Latin too long even as a consonant skeleton (3.03).

Consonant signs with vowels in the marks: mean fits Spanish (2.22 consonants per word) but the distribution does not (f. 85: 98% of groups 1-3 signs, none over 4; Spanish consonant counts 17% at 4 or more).

Groups as syllables spelled letter for letter: length distribution matches Spanish syllables (13/59/26/3% vs 8/56/29/6%), but no set of 4-6 signs occurs exactly once per group (best 64%, shuffled controls 60-63%, real Spanish syllables 89%).

First many-to-one substitution anneal collapsed to 'iiii' (Roman numerals in the corpora); then swap-only moves could not reach keys with more homophones than the start. Fixed: numeral tokens dropped, reassignment moves, no letter above twice its share.

Many-to-one substitution anneal of the Gomez stream (raw and F3/B3 merged) on letters-only order-4 es-golden-age, it-cinquecento and la models: real scores -2.78 (es), -2.70 (it), -2.65 (la) per char on the raw stream, gibberish.
Same-length passages enciphered with the same number of signs: recovered 99% (es), 100% (it), 99% (la) on the raw setting, scores -1.81/-1.78/-2.15. Merged: la 99%, es 48%, it 0%.
Consonant-skeleton models (vowels deleted): controls recovered only 3-24%, so the skeleton runs on the real stream say nothing.
position_test.py: signs prefer the start or end of a group (skew 0.41; shuffled median 0.24, 99th percentile 0.33).

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only tests on the 2012 transcription; the system was narrowed (not letter substitution, not letter-spelled syllables), no key.
